body.x: VersaWare officially debuted its new nutrition AI approach to the health and wellness space at CES 2023. It said the company designed the user-friendly appliance line composed of two connected smart kitchen appliances — a mixing bowl and a cutting board. It also introduced the VersaWare mobile app that helps users to cook meals satisfying their preferred nutritional goals. VersaWare seeks to make measuring tools or ‘guess-and-check’ ingredient portions into history.

body.cap: VersaWare's connected cutting board with scales and smart panel integrated | Photo by AVING News

body.x: As athletes, Jacob Lindberg and Creed McKinnon discovered that current solutions from competitors to monitor calories and nutrient intake are confusing and ineffective. They founded VersaWare and invented its Smart kitchen nutrition system to resolve the problem.

“The conventional process of monitoring and tracking the food you eat is a hassle that is time-consuming, labor intensive, and frankly inaccurate,” said McKinnon. “It should not be a burden to simply understand the breakdown of what we eat ... we realized that data paired with the weight of the corresponding ingredients would make this process as quick and easy as possible – it is a game changer for nutritionally conscious individuals.”

body.cap: VersaWare's connected mixing bowl with scales and smart panel integrated | Photo by AVING News

body.x: VersaWare stated that its product differs from other competitors as it allows users to design nutritional meals without estimating portion sizes or logging caloric intake via manual programs. The company continued that its nutrition system using OpenAPI has a rich database of products, enabling end-users to scan nearly every brand.

With VersaWare, a user cooking a meal scans barcodes (for packaged ingredients) and inputs queries (for unpackaged fresh ingredients), then place those in the digital appliances for calculation. Its AI allows users to build a variety of meals based on nutritional composition in real time by displaying the nutrition of an entire meal.

body.cap: Demonstration video of VersaWare's mixing bowl | Photo by AVING News

body.x: VersaWare promised its product supplies individuals with the tools to custom-create a meal meeting their desired nutritional goals - without forcing them to clutter the kitchen, log every information into a mobile app, or use separate food scales and measurement devices.

VersaWare concluded shipping its production units to beta users and started the data collection. Following CES 2023, the brand plans to launch its seed round of investment while expecting full-level production in Summer 2023.
